featured_reviews.name: Komal Gala
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Estilo Electronics, and I was thoroughly impressed with both the quality of their products and their exceptional customer service.
The staff was knowledgeable, friendly, and ready to help with all my questions. They guided me through various options and even recommended products based on my needs rather than pushing the most expensive items.
The store was well-organized and had a great selection of electronics, from the latest gadgets to reliable accessories. Overall, I’m very happy with my purchase, and I’ll definitely be back for any future electronics needs. Highly recommended!"

featured_reviews.name: Kartik Shivram
featured_reviews.review_text: I went into purchase a tv and the sales representative was absolutely prompt, helpful and proactive. Before visiting the shop I had also contacted them and the sales representative Mr Khaleel provided all information on phone itself, making my decision making process very simple and easy. Finally the delivery was done on same day within 3 hours of the purchase and was given the best market rate also. Overall a superb experience and great customer service approach

featured_reviews.name: v san
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent store for all LG products. Mr.Paresh was most amazing and attentive. He not only helped me out with great offers for air conditioner but went out of his way to help. The products were delivered promptly and Pareshbhai helped even post delivery and during installation. He assisted like a family member. Truly grateful for his help and hats off to his excellent customer service. Really people like him make all the difference when you want to buy a product. Totally recommend this place

featured_reviews.name: Picsup001
featured_reviews.review_text:
Samsung plaza has variety of product but not in laptop as on the shop there was only a pro version available as i was looking for book 3.
And it took 5 days to get them the book 3 and thats a long wait. Dint expect such delay with such a big brand. I have veen using S series flagship phone from many year so thought making an ecosystem but was very disappointed with the delay of product. And also staff should have educate knowledge of laptop version and feature.

featured_reviews.name: Paresh Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: I have purchased 3 appliances so far from Samsung plaza Estilo Ghatkopar and my experience has been very good. The prices offered by them have been very competent and their sales person Rupesh is very responsive and helpful. I recommend this shop for any of your Samsung appliances related purchases. Thank you team Estilo and Rupesh.
